newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 78.1 bln marks in tender at 3.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 78.1 bln marks in tender at 3.0 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Friday it allocated securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed three percent rate, the rate that has prevailed since late August.

The central bank accepted bids for 78.1 billion marks of the 12-day funds. A repo pact for 73.9 billion marks at a fixed three percent rate expires, so a net 4.2 billion marks is flowing into the market.
The Bundesbank said it accepted 35.5 percent of the bids.
